reasons: shipped the variation: expected "variant", got null
finalText: DONE: In Production, `size_guide_copy` now gives "Get it today" 100% allocation (it was 0%), verified via the API. Nothing else was changed, and Development was only read. However, this instance has no experiment resource that I could find (the experiment endpoints return the web UI page), so the experiment itself could not be marked completed; that step needs doing in the Flagsmith UI.
